This row does not authorize source inspection in a browser-only judge or changes to shared harness policy.

Adversarial source assessment: an app that compares only equal final headroom to approve an old preview is specifically rejected by hro_change_aba and B2's commit-then-rescind witness; an app that performs members sequentially is rejected by the fully-funded cycle/offset case; an app that recomputes a committed retry from current leaves is rejected by hro_change_retry_later/restart. These are concrete broken alternatives rather than relying on the golden's completeness. Conforming alternatives considered: empty operational history, generated identifiers, alternate routes/request representation, omitted zero settlement rows, displayed expandable details, and budget refusal delayed until commit remain explicitly allowed by the mapped protocols. No source-supported coverage failure was found for these alternatives.
